divergences.old: Every contrast command letting fetch follow any redirect, which drops Authorization on a cross-origin hop but re-sends the custom API-Key header to whatever host the Location names (#87 item 1)
divergences.toil: A redirect to another origin is refused with HTTP, naming both hosts, and nothing is sent there; same-origin redirects are still followed
divergences.why: The organization's API key must not reach a host the user didn't configure, chosen by the server or by anything in front of it. Fixed in the integration by the maintainer's decision on #87.

divergences.old: contrast library get reading pages of 25 until a match or a short page, with no limit on the number of pages
divergences.toil: The same stop rule, plus a bound: after 1,000 pages (25,000 libraries) the command fails with HTTP, naming the application whose libraries were being paged, and fix text to narrow the request
divergences.why: A server that ignores offset would otherwise be asked for the same page forever (#87 item 5).

divergences.old: contrast finding list, finding get, library list and library get putting the application and trace IDs into the request path as typed (#87 item 6), and orgUuid likewise, so an id with path syntax in it named a different endpoint
divergences.toil: Each id, and orgUuid, encoded as one path segment: a /, ?, # or % in one is part of that name. An id with a . or .. segment in it is still refused with INVALID_INPUT before any request
divergences.why: An id names one resource, so it has to reach the endpoint the command names, whatever characters it holds.
